text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa…… T-time……
Aww, no improvement from before……!
choice_data_list: Let's take a break. Do you remembe...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um…… rushing due to anxiety, right?
Forcing pace and breaking running form.
choice_data_list: Yeah. For now, don't worry about time
Yeah. For now, don't worry about time

text_block_list.text:
Wanted her running calmly without rush for
now.
Reduce physical and mental training
strain――

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
To recall pre-injury form……
Right? I-I'll do my best for justice……!
choice_data_list: Let's not rush and build up gradually!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ……Yes!

Current Zenno Rob Roy lacked objective
view of own strength. Needed her to start
believing in herself……!
Few days later――

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Why does body feel so light……?
Only ran freely at own pace lately……)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(……Yes, exactly. No need to rush.
Trainer-san believes in my strength after
all.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Must believe in myself just as strongly
as Trainer-san believes in me……!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I can do this……!

……Few days before Sports Festival,
library. Zenno
Rob Roy researched lore regarding "Hero
Search."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
……No mistake. Trainer-san denied it, but……
Kris S-san truly is our destined Hero.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
At this time, on this course,
on that date.
No matter how you look at this data,
it could only be Kris S-san……

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
……This truth…… I don't…… want to tell
them……

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I must. At the Sports Festival,
I'll compete
against Kris S-san and lose…… and then I'll
reveal everything and bring this tale to a
close.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (That is why, until then……)

And so,
the day of the Sports Festival arrived!
Zenno Rob Roy was――

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(N-no way! It can't be……! Why today,
of all days, did I miss the start……?)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Kris S-san's back is pulling further and
further away……
at this rate,
she'll completely fade from my sight……)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(……Just as I thought,
I cannot win. There was no way
I ever could.
Even after all that rigorous training we
endured……)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
choice_data_list: You're the main character, Rob Roy!!
You're the main character, Rob Roy!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I…… could I truly be the hero of this
story?)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(If I manage to triumph over Kris S-san,
what awaits?
Will my own chronicle begin? If so――)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Even beyond the Sports Festival,
even after our
true hero is revealed…… will Trainer-san
still wish
to witness a tale where I am the
protagonist?)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (I want them to…… with all my heart!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Haa――aaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
What a turn of events!
Zenno Rob Roy begins her charge here!
But heading into the final stretch,
Symboli Kris S still holds a commanding
lead!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Watch closely, Trainer-san.
As the sole reader of my heroic epic……!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist of this tale…… is me!
Taaaaaaaaaaaa!

I finally realized it. It was a fierce,
relentless, desperate run.
Yet brimming with noble pride―― exactly like
the Hero I witnessed on that day!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa…… haaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――So, you have reached this far.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S unleashes a breathtaking
burst of speed before the line! Faster,
ever faster! True to expectations,
today's leading star is undeniably her!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And she crosses the finish line first!
Symboli Kris S claims a decisive victory!

Thunderous applause and cheers erupted from
the stands.
Of course―― it was all offered to the
conqueror.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(……I lost…… Just as expected.
Legends are not written so easily.
That is why I must speak up.
I must let go of this fantasy.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
……Trainer-san!
Um, about the true identity of that Hero――

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: You were―― huh?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Eh? W-what do you mean by that?
Why are you bringing that up all of a
sudden……?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy, about the race―― oh,
are you occupied?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Kris S-san! Perfect timing,
there is something crucial I must ask
you……!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
――So, on that day around 4 PM!
You were using the outer turf course,
correct……?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Affirmative.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Together with you―― we were running drills
side-by-side.
As for the exact time―― I cannot confirm――

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
S-see?
I witnessed it with my very own eyes!
There is no mistaking that the Hero was Kris
S-san!
choice_data_list: Hold on, if you were practicing to...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Rob Roy was there as well.
choice_data_list: Did you have your hair tied back?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes…… I believe so.
choice_data_list: And you almost tripped and fell?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
How could you have seen that?
Then…… that means…… ehhh?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Eh――

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ……Eeeeeeeh?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Understood. You ARE preoccupied.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Afterward I was injured and could barely
run,
so you could not confirm that the Hero was
actually me……

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
……I am astonished.
So from the very beginning…… you were watching
over me.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
……I told you before,
didn't I?
A heroic tale only becomes an epic once
someone begins to narrate the hero's
journey.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Therefore,
Trainer-san! I shall give my absolute all!
From this day forth,
I will make you want to weave this story
forever.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Together,
let us script it to the very end.
『The Heroic Epic of Zenno Rob Roy』……!

She spoke with a radiant smile.
And that marked the opening prologue to a
grand, heroic chronicle.
